Простой смертный Норин-Рат решил принести себя в жертву ради спасения родной планеты Зен-Ла. Он поступил на службу к Галактусу с условием, что тот пощадит его планету. Так погиб Норин-Рат и появился Серебряный сёрфер, наделённый частью мощи Галактуса. Теперь всё космическое общество презирает и ненавидит Серебряного сёрфера, видя в нём приспешника пожирателя миров. Ведь именно сёрфер, как верный пёс, отыскивает для Галактуса новые миры, которые тот может поглотить. Никто не знает о благородной миссии сёрфера, поклявшегося указывать Галактусу только необитаемые планеты и спасшего таким образом множество цивилизаций. Космический сёрфинг уже начался. Ворвись в океан приключений вместе с Серебряным сёрфером!

items.overview: Много тысяч лет назад люди совершили большую ошибку, и за нее пришлось слишком дорого платить. На земле случилась катастрофа, ужасный Армагеддон, стер с лица земли все, те, кому удалось выжить, завидовали тем, кто умер. Потому что не только беда спустилась на землю, но и какие-то неведомые существа. Но люди в прошлом уже видели похожих существ, а потом они сравнили их с теми, что были много лет назад, и поняли что это вампиры. Но природный круговорот очень умен и жесток. Люди тоже употребляют в пищу животных, а вампиры соответственно людей. А это значит, что есть и такие существа, которым придутся по вкусу вампиры. И к кому примкнут эти существа? Что их ожидает среди вампиров и людей, которые постоянно воюют между собой. С кем они будут дружить, а с кем воевать?

Ресурсы оказались не безграничными и постепенно стали иссякать. Рождаемость падала, и люди решили вернуться на свою родную планету, но, к сожалению, планета не могла принять их всех. На этой почве разразилась война, которая получила название «Война за возвращение». Она продолжалась, пока однажды не создали правительство — «Коалиция Гая», которая объявила о том, что Земля священна, и никто не смеет на неё возвращаться. Земля стала чем-то далёким и недосягаемым, в то время как колонисты на умирающих планетах ждали своей кончины. Однако космический пират Харлок с этим не согласен. На своем корабле «Аркадия» он грабил корабли корпорации на протяжении последних ста лет. Главный герой, агент главнокомандующего правительственного флота Эзры, вступает на борт «Аркадии» для раскрытия целей Харлока и его команды, но впоследствии начинает сомневаться в правильности своего решения.

items.overview: After taking one hundred secret photos and observing him from afar for months, second-year high schooler Yuki Kurihara has finally mustered up the courage to ask out her first-year crush Shinya "Momo" Momotsuki. Although taken by surprise, the bashful Momo accepts; however, he does not know the profoundly abnormal truth. As her strait-laced friend, Norika Mizuyama, has observed, Yuki has developed some unnerving—but nonetheless sincere—habits: taking pictures of Momo in secret, doing extensive research into his personal life, collecting his used straws, and even going "Momo watching." Though Momo remains blissfully unaware of his new girlfriend's peculiar habits, he does notice some oddities in their daily conversations. Still unsure and nervous about his first relationship, Momo finds himself regularly getting into awkward interactions due to his inexperience, but nevertheless resolves to make his new girlfriend happy. Momokuri follows Yuki and Momo as they shyly explore their newfound love, and also deal with the problems that arise from it. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.overview: Moving from Tokyo to Okinawa island, Teruaki "Teru" Nakamura unexpectedly falls in love with his outgoing classmate Hina Kyan, who readily ensures he feels included at his new high school. However, due to her strong local dialect, Teru often has a hard time understanding what Hina is saying. Even so, Hina continues to passionately explain the diverse Okinawan culture to him. Fortunately for Teru, Hina's best friend Kana Higa is eager to help with translation and even offers to teach him useful words and phrases. Yet, Kana has her own reasons—she has developed a crush on Teru and uses this opportunity to talk to him. As Teru, Hina, and Kana spend more time together, unaware of one another's feelings, Teru learns more about his new home and enjoys the company of his friends. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.overview: In modern-day Japan, 13-year-old Hajime Yasaka moves to the countryside to stay with his grandfather. On the way to his new home, a lost Hajime finds himself in a cafe called Ark, where he immediately falls in love with one of the waitresses: the gorgeous Sayoko "Arashi" Arashiyama. While Arashi is initially unconcerned with the boy, her attitude quickly changes after she grasps Hajime's hand, leading her to believe they are "connected." As it turns out, Arashi is anything but a regular teenager—in reality, she is the ghost of a girl who perished in World War II. By touching a man she connects with, she gains the ability to travel back in time. Delighted to have found someone who can unlock her powers, Arashi asks Hajime to help with her mission: to save civilians from the carnage of the war that claimed her life. Smitten with Arashi, Hajime readily agrees. But as the two get further involved with Arashi's past, they soon discover that she is not the only one able to transcend time. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

items.overview: The battle against Tendou Kodzunu is over, and the Magami Five begin to look forward to their senior graduation, hopefully planning for their adult futures. What is the purpose of this cruel turn of events? And who ordered the hit? New threats emerge as others awakened to powers unleashed by the Ryumyaku seek out the Magami kids - and old friends now return as enemies. Destinies will collide as the Stars of Fate begin to merge; Yin and Yang will meet. And soon the shadowy figure pulling the strings will reveal himself, in an effort to raze Tokyo to the ground and awaken the Vessel of the Golden Dragon.

items.overview: Losing their war against Heaven's angel army, the demons of Hell are on the cusp of collapse. As a last ditch attempt to turn the tides of the war, the demons send Akutsu Masatora to the mortal plane on Earth to save their homeland from the angels. Disguising himself as a high school student, Akutsu seeks to recruit someone with the capability to lead the demons to victory. Akutsu does not have to look far: among his classmates is the magnificent Lily Amane, a transfer student who seems like the perfect candidate for Akutsu's plans. But as luck would have it, Lily is one of the very angels that Akutsu is meant to be fighting against, and his attempt to recruit her might end up being the biggest blunder in the failing war. Worse yet, Akutsu may fall in love with his own worst enemy. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
